Smart Bulk Paste

Do tarike se paste karo:
1. Sirf item names — Excel ki item name wali column copy karke paste karo (ek line me ek naam). Code/UOM/Category Nexus khud master se bhar dega.
2. Item Name + UOM + Vendor — tab-separated (Excel ki teen columns saath).
Jo item master me na mile, wo red highlight honge — unhe aap theek kar sakte ho.
